title: Enterprise Security Architecture Gap Map v1 — Rig Relay

security_areas.current_state: Threat model v0 with 17 threats, 6 mitigations, 5 release gates. References OWASP LLM Top 10 and WebSocket Cheat Sheet.
gaps: No prompt injection defense (T01, T02 critical/open)
No data exfiltration prevention (T03 critical/open)
No generated docs XSS scan (T12, T13 high/open)
No supply-chain scanning (T16 low/open)
security_areas.remediation: Implement prompt injection classifier. Add automated XSS scan. Implement dependency vulnerability scanning.

security_areas.current_state: Loopback-only binding (127.0.0.1). TLS available. WebSocket requires auth token. Message validation with size limits (64KB). Invalid message guard (3 strikes).
gaps: No rate limiting on WebSocket
No per-message scope enforcement
No CSRF protection on HTTP routes (non-WS)
security_areas.remediation: Add rate limiting. Add per-subscription scope enforcement. Add CSRF tokens for HTTP routes.

security_areas.current_state: Tool permission gating (ALWAYS/ASK/NEVER). Patch gating for mutation tools. Bash pattern detection. Environment scrubbing (28 vars). Binary rejection. Symlink protection. Sensitive path blocking.
gaps: No tool argument validation against schema before execution
No mission-scoped tool permission profiles
No tool call budget/rate limiting
No automated secret detection in tool output
security_areas.remediation: Add tool argument validation. Implement mission-scoped permissions. Add tool call rate limiting. Add post-hoc secret scan.

security_areas.current_state: Dirty-file preservation. Collision warnings. Checkpoint-only commits. No git amend/force-push/reset. Patch gating for mutation tools. Desktop intent API requires authorization.
gaps: No atomic worktree merge validation
No cross-lane mutation guard
No pre-write file ownership check
security_areas.remediation: Implement atomic worktree merge validation. Add cross-lane mutation detection. Add pre-write ownership check.

security_areas.current_state: Implemented and enforced. Protected files cannot be discarded. Additive edits preferred. Cross-session coordination tracks path reservations.
gaps: No automated verification that dirty files are never modified by agents
Collision detection is warning-only, not blocking
security_areas.remediation: Add automated dirty-file integrity tests. Consider making collision detection blocking for write reservations.

security_areas.current_state: Bash pattern detection blocks command substitution, inline execution, env injection, backslash-escaped paths. Sensitive path blocking. Bash rerouting to safer tools.
gaps: No explicit denylist of destructive commands (rm -rf, format, dd, etc.)
Pattern detection may have bypasses
No filesystem operation journaling
security_areas.remediation: Add explicit destructive command denylist. Audit pattern detection for bypasses. Consider filesystem snapshots before mutations.

security_areas.current_state: OS keychain preferred. .env file fallback. Token redaction in all traces/docs/frontend. No token in URLs. ProviderKeyStore with multiple backends.
gaps: No key rotation support
No token usage audit
No automated token scanning on persisted files
.env file is plaintext (acceptable for local dev, not enterprise)
security_areas.remediation: Add key rotation workflow. Add token usage audit trail. Add automated token scanning. Document credential storage best practices.

security_areas.current_state: GitHub and Google OAuth providers. Loopback server for OAuth redirect. Token store with encryption preference. Consent store. Step-up authorization for sensitive actions.
gaps: No OAuth token revocation on session end
No provider permission scope verification at runtime
No OAuth PKCE enforcement (optional in some flows)
security_areas.remediation: Add token revocation on session end. Add runtime scope verification. Enforce PKCE for all OAuth flows.

security_areas.current_state: GitHub App permission posture documented in JSON. 53-file integration package with code scanning, PR mutation, security lifecycle. Permission matrix artifact exists.
gaps: No runtime permission scope validation for GitHub tokens
No procurement-facing permission summary
No least-privilege enforcement for different operations
security_areas.remediation: Add runtime scope verification. Produce procurement-facing GitHub App permission summary. Implement per-operation least-privilege.

security_areas.current_state: Content-light doctrine comprehensive. Four-category model: product telemetry (first-party, default-on, opt-out), remote telemetry contribution (settings-controlled, consent-gated), local operational observability (mandatory for governed operation), enterprise audit/evidence (mandatory in enterprise mode). Redaction validator on all export paths. Three-tier retention model. Content-light guarantee enforced at bundle creation.
gaps: No automated continuous verification that all emission paths comply
No independent audit of content-light guarantee
Redaction validator scope limited to export paths, not all write paths
No automated enforcement that product-telemetry opt-out preserves audit/evidence continuity
security_areas.remediation: Add CI-based content-light verification on all artifact writes. Expand redaction validator to cover all persistence paths. Add tests proving product-telemetry opt-out does not disable governance/audit/evidence records.

security_areas.current_state: Two bundle scripts (chatgpt_dev, telemetry). Both content-light. No raw prompts, model outputs, source code, diffs, or secrets. Debug bundle command deferred.
gaps: No unified debug bundle command
No enterprise quarantine workflow
No support ticket integration
No debug bundle retention policy
security_areas.remediation: Unify debug bundle scripts. Add enterprise quarantine workflow. Document support packet policy.

security_areas.current_state: HTML escaping on content. No raw HTML blocks in JSON docs. Path redaction in renderer. Generated content validated. No script injection from source JSON possible.
gaps: No CSP headers on generated HTML
No automated XSS scan of generated output
No regular scan for absolute paths or token-like strings in static HTML
security_areas.remediation: Add CSP meta tag. Implement automated XSS scan in CI. Add content-light scan for generated HTML.

security_areas.current_state: Frontend rendering safety doctrine (8 rules). textContent for untrusted content. No eval(). No dynamic code execution. All mutations through backend intent API. No raw tokens in frontend storage.
gaps: No CSP headers served by bridge server
No Content-Type enforcement on static assets
No XSS test suite for frontend components
innerHTML permitted for backend-authored widgets (trust boundary risk)
security_areas.remediation: Add CSP headers to bridge server. Add XSS test suite. Audit backend-authored widget HTML for injection.

security_areas.current_state: Loopback-only. TLS available. Auth token required. Origin validation (allow loopback HTTP/HTTPS, reject foreign/file/null). Auth-before-subscribe enforced. Message validation (non-JSON/array/scalar rejected, missing type rejected, token-on-non-auth rejected). Invalid message guard (3 strikes, connection close). MAX_MESSAGE_BYTES=64KB.
gaps: No per-message MAC/signing
No message replay protection
No WebSocket connection rate limiting
No token rotation during session
security_areas.remediation: Add message signing for high-integrity messages. Add connection rate limiting. Consider token rotation.

security_areas.current_state: RuntimeSupervisor with asyncio.create_subprocess_exec (no shell). Timeout enforcement. Bounded stdout/stderr buffers. Cancel → terminate → kill escalation. Content-light completion/failure summaries with SHA256 hashes.
gaps: No resource limits (CPU, memory) on subprocesses
No network egress controls for subprocesses
No process tree cleanup guarantee (grandchildren may survive)
No seccomp/sandbox on Linux
security_areas.remediation: Add resource limits (rlimit). Add network egress controls. Implement process group cleanup. Consider seccomp sandboxing.

security_areas.current_state: Trust tier labeling on context sources. Content assembly SHA256-hashed. Excludes generated HTML from context packs. Code schema authority hash verification.
gaps: No content sanitization before context injection
No user-visible summary of what context is sent to each provider
No injection scan on repo content before assembly
Stale schema detection not automated
security_areas.remediation: Add content sanitization. Show context summary to user. Add injection scan. Automate stale schema detection.

security_areas.current_state: Content-light trace doctrine. No raw file contents, secrets, or private code in telemetry. SHA256 hashes for content-derived values. Structured logging with positional args (not f-strings).
gaps: No automated secret scan on trace writes
No trace content size limits
No log-level-based redaction (DEBUG may contain sensitive data)
No log retention policy for DEBUG logs
security_areas.remediation: Add automated secret scanner for trace events. Add trace size limits. Document log-level safety. Add log retention policy.

critical_findings: No prompt injection defenses implemented (threat model T01, T02 open/critical)
No XSS/CSP on frontend or static docs
No data exfiltration prevention for tool-calling agents
No content sanitization before context injection
No automated security scanning across all emission paths
